---
name: V1 plugin compatibility
about: Report an unchanged V1 plugin workflow that works or fails
---

## Plugin and workflow

Include the exact plugin name and version, a public source link if available, and the behavior you tested.

## Environment and outcome

Include bridge and OpenCode versions, OS, relevant redacted options, and what worked or failed. State whether the plugin was unchanged and whether the result is native or offline.

## Minimal evidence

Share reproducible steps and redacted diagnostics. Describe relevant tools, client calls or hooks if known.
